about: Writing-policy placement and preservation cases (2026-10-06). Each case seeds a small document with apply_edits operations, names the instruction a user would give, and records the reviewed expected outcome: which obligations must survive, in which PART, and what must not appear. reviewed_edit is one operation set that reaches that outcome; lossy_edits are deliberate failures the assessor (tools/writing_policy_eval.py) must catch. The source requirements are illustrative, not recommended technical selections. Hermetic tests run every case; the owner-run evaluation sends the instruction to the model and assesses what it drafts.
